content.comment_body: Does anyone know how to disable password protection for downloading or going online? I tried using the transfer and clear password options in the [product_name] program, but I still receive a password prompt.

If a password protects the program, you can only download the program from the [product_name] with the password. Without the password, access is restricted unless you use the 'Clear User Program and Password' feature, which deletes both program and password. This is found under 'Tools > Transfer'. Online mode does not have a separate password. If you continue having issues, please share a screenshot of the error message.

Thanks, I already tried clearing both the program and password via transfer options, but when I attempt to download the program again, it continues asking for a password. I never set a custom password; it remains at the default 'LOGO'. I attached a screenshot showing the password prompt during online access.

I tested this with my [article_no] device. The process works as described: I transferred the program and password, used the clear function, and received a success message. Afterwards, downloading the existing program resulted in a blank diagram and no password prompt.

I did the same procedure with my [product_name] [version_no] module, but it still asks for a password. Also, your [product_name] software runs much faster—mine takes tens of seconds to download or go online, even when connected via Ethernet directly to [product_name].

I do not have the latest [product_name] [version_no] hardware and can't test your scenario directly. Multiple users have reported bugs both in [version_no] hardware and [product_name] [version_no] software, so this may be another issue. In your situation, contacting support would be a good step.

Hello, when you remotely connect to [product_name], there is at least one password that cannot be deleted. You must set a password for remote access under 'Tools/access control'; this cannot be removed. With a VPN, it generally acts like a direct connection within the same subnet, but you’ll still need a password and appropriate router configuration. Slow data transfer happens when the connection to [product_name] isn’t in the same subnet; this increases transfer time due to encryption. Using 'delete user program and password' deletes the program and its password, but not the remote access password. Hope this clarifies things.

Thank you. I am not using remote access—my [product_name] connects by Ethernet directly to my laptop. Regarding slow transfers, what do you mean by 'not directly in the same subnet'? Both devices are on the same subnet and otherwise communication would not work. PC: 192.168.1.150/24, [product_name]: 192.168.1.100/24.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum discussions reveal challenges in removing or bypassing password prompts when downloading or accessing [product_name] hardware with [product_name] configuration software, particularly when no custom password has been set. Attempts to clear programs and passwords per official instructions sometimes do not resolve the prompt, hinting at possible bugs or hidden device behaviors. The problem appears inconsistent between hardware/software versions and is confused further by distinctions between local and remote access password requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that following documented procedures to clear programs and passwords will remove any password prompts and allow unrestricted downloading or online access to their [product_name] devices.
